The '''High King's Guard''' was a [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchical]] institution on the [[Imzig]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Couronne/Legends|Couronne]]. [[Utris M'Toc]], a former member of the High King's Guard, forcibly fled the<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SW article">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-maps-charting-the-galaxy|text=''Star Wars'' Maps: Charting the Galaxy|nolive=1}}</ref> after a [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] coup, eventually transitioning to a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security]] position with the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />

==Behind the scenes==
The High King's Guard was created for the [[Star Wars Insider 148|''Star Wars Insider'' 148]] article "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud Wing Guards]],"<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> published on [[March 11]], [[2014]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/148|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #148}}</ref> Contributor [[Kevin Beentjes]] developed the High King's Guard as part of the backstory for character Utris M'Toc of the planet Couronne.<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/naming-the-cloud-city-wing-guards/714850175231759|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=Mar 6, 2014|quote='''Utris M'toc''': Now has a homeplanet, as does his species, the Imzig. Kevin, who created M'toc's background, asked additional information about Couronne at Jason Fry, since it was a planet with no background at all from The Atlas.}}</ref>
